slide_text.slide_02_title: Why water mobility matters in Egypt
slide_text.slide_03_body:
Egypt's Red Sea Riviera — Hurghada and Sharm El Sheikh — runs constant boat traffic to Giftun Island and Ras Mohammed. Two luxury-belt routes are grounded on labeled destination-pool demand and premium day-trip fares under captive capture; three further Red Sea routes stay held. Cairo is out of scope (Nile); Alexandria remains candidate/null until a scheduled network is proven.

2 coastal cities in scope  ·  2 supported routes  ·  $7.4M supported annual route revenue  ·  20 vessels supported

slide_text.slide_04_body: Giftun Island is Hurghada's flagship excursion — white-sand islands and the Orange Bay and Mahmya reefs, reached by boat and drawing roughly 187,000 visitors a year.
slide_text.slide_05_body: Ras Mohammed's reefs rank among the Red Sea's finest dive and snorkel sites, reached by boat from Sharm and drawing about 50,000 visitors a year.
slide_text.slide_06_title: Route economics: Hurghada Marina → Giftun Island (Orange Bay / Mahmya)
slide_text.slide_06_body: Representative route: Hurghada Marina → Giftun Island (Orange Bay / Mahmya). Flagship Red Sea luxury-belt excursion; provisional unit-economics anchor pending Jaideep's choice between Giftun and Ras Mohammed. Annual passenger demand, one-way fare, annual revenue, fleet support, and payback are shown for this route from the sourced route model.
slide_text.slide_07_title: Two boat-only routes are the floor — the Red Sea day-trip market sits well above them
slide_text.slide_07_body:
Two boat-only routes are the floor — the Red Sea day-trip market sits well above them

Two boat-only routes we can size today: Journey spend pool on Giftun + Ras Mohammed only. Navier revenue floor at ~90% captive capture is ~$7.65M. This is the FLOOR, not the market.
The wider Red Sea day-trip boat market (Hurghada alone): Hurghada ~1.9M arrivals (2023, UNWTO) × labelled 35–55% participation × $32. Sharm and other resorts are held upside.
Egypt marine-mobility opportunity: Red Sea day-trips (rung 2 + held resorts). Nile and Alexandria HELD NULL. Egypt tourism economy is context only.
